name: Flowbite
summary: Open-source Tailwind CSS component library with 56+ component types, Figma design files, SVG icons and a paid Pro version.
description: Open-source UI component library built on Tailwind CSS. Install it as an npm plugin or CDN script; interactive components (dropdowns, modals, tooltips, date pickers) work through data attributes or init functions, with TypeScript support. Ships with a Figma design system, 430+ SVG icons, framework guides and a Pro version with 450+ sections and pages.
contains: over 56 types of UI components built with Tailwind CSS
install via npm plugin, CDN or bundled JS
interactive components via data attributes or JS init functions with TypeScript support
Figma design system based on the Tailwind CSS classes
Pro version: 450+ sections and advanced UI components
framework guides: React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Astro and more
